problem_restatement: Determine whether the frozen V58 eight-asset topology produces attributable, executable opportunity and same-cycle exposure before treating its 46% configured margin envelope as economically supported.

increment_from_prior_disposition.comparison_note: The v2 diagnostic excludes readiness seeds and deduplicates exact provider decisions, so its evaluation count is not subtracted from the broader v1 audit count. The new eligible ETH event is exact and direction-authorized.

threshold_reconciliation.diagnostic_threshold: at least one attributable eligible decision and one technically resolved lifecycle per configured side
threshold_reconciliation.change_threshold: at least ten technically complete source-compatible lifecycles per route, at least three per configured side, exact after-cost nominal and stress results, and largest-winner sensitivity

interpretation.technical: V58 is producing source-compatible evaluations and one executable ETH opportunity without identity drift or unauthorized direction leakage.
interpretation.economic: One unresolved long cannot identify route expectancy, portfolio cadence, side robustness, or co-trigger loss behavior.
interpretation.risk: The observed maximum simultaneous margin was 3%, not 46%. This does not prove the larger envelope safe or unsafe; it means the prefix contains no empirical multi-symbol stress event.
interpretation.decision: Continue the frozen report-only observer and resolve the ETH lifecycle without retuning. Do not promote V58 automatically from this prefix.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.investigation: Resolve the exact ETH long under its frozen 60-bps stop, eligible opposite-signal exit, and 12-hour maximum hold, including visible-depth exit, taker fees, official funding, and technical completeness.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.reason: It is the only exact executable opportunity in the current V58 run and therefore the only new lifecycle capable of updating the route-level diagnosis without changing the strategy.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.parallel_report_only_collection: Continue HYPE alignment-v2 and SP500 fresh15-v3 observation under their unchanged identities; neither produced an eligible event in this prefix.

fifteen_field_change_review.1_recommendation: Continue the isolated V58 observer; make no automatic live change from this prefix.
fifteen_field_change_review.2_why_now: The first executable ETH event proves liveness but remains open, one-sided, and uncorrelated with another symbol.
fifteen_field_change_review.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact V58 config, observer-rebound identity, 4,905-row immutable ledger prefix, opportunity/co-trigger report, and ETH exact-depth partial lifecycle.
fifteen_field_change_review.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: The eight-asset topology is technically observable, but only ETH has produced an eligible opportunity and no route has a newly resolved lifecycle.
fifteen_field_change_review.5_applicable_market_regime: The ETH event was a fresh aligned five-minute upside breakout after compression and a negative one-minute pullback; other routes remained ineligible under their own frozen contracts.
6_alternatives_considered: activate V58 from technical readiness alone
remove the unresolved ETH route immediately
continue the frozen observer and resolve the native exit
fifteen_field_change_review.8_expected_upside: Obtains an unbiased native-exit outcome and actual future co-trigger evidence without manufacturing cadence or changing capital exposure.
9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: The ETH lifecycle may stop and the route may have negative expectancy.
The observer window may remain too sparse for a useful portfolio estimate.
Recorded depth is not a guaranteed live fill.
Keeping the candidate inactive can miss profitable opportunities if the unproven routes have real edge.
fifteen_field_change_review.10_validation_completed: Profile derivation, source prefix, route direction, eligibility, per-symbol margin, same-cycle deduplication, no-authority contract, and artifact hashes reconcile.
fifteen_field_change_review.11_validation_still_required: ETH native-exit resolution, short-side evidence, route-level samples, exact costs, largest-winner sensitivity, and multi-symbol co-trigger observations.
fifteen_field_change_review.12_success_metrics: Technically complete source-compatible lifecycles with positive after-cost nominal/stress and leave-largest results, both configured sides represented where applicable, and measured portfolio overlap.
fifteen_field_change_review.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Invalidate the prefix on profile, config, ledger-prefix, direction, source, fee, funding, stop, exit, or technical-path mismatch. No rollback applies because no live change was made.

falsifiers: A later exact prefix produces additional executable symbols or materially larger same-cycle margin.
The ETH lifecycle resolves and changes the route-level after-cost assessment.
A source-compatible route reaches the preregistered change threshold with exact leave-largest evidence.
Any observer identity, config hash, direction authority, prefix hash, or technical-path reconciliation fails.
